snippet.title: Homura Hime: Nintendo Switch 2 — Coming 2027
snippet.description:
https://playism.com/en/game/homura-hime/

Officially coming to Nintendo Switch 2 in 2027!
Homura Hime is a 3D action game that strives to combine stunning anime visuals with gripping bullet hell combat. Fight archdemons born from strong emotions and learn their stories by Homura Hime's side.
